measuredOn: Windows (verify-coverage-baseline.py per-package runs; #1535 include contract: every package now counts ALL production src/**/*.ts(x) in the denominator via app/test-config/coverage.ts factory. Web/desktop/mobile numbers dropped vs the 2026-08-02 baseline because untested production modules now enter the denominator — truth revealed, not a relaxation. e2e Playwright specs (src/__e2e__/**) and pure entry main.tsx are the only narrow exclusions; see config comments.)
ciPlatform: ubuntu-latest (v8 coverage is execution-path based; numbers are cross-platform deterministic)
policy: Coverage baseline gate — numbers must not regress. If a metric drops below the value recorded here (minus the v8 run-to-run tolerance), the gate fails (exit 1). Absolute floors in each vitest config enforce a hard minimum independent of the baseline. uncoveredFiles (0%-line production modules) must not grow — new untested code or a deleted test trips it. A second assertion requires skipped tests == 0 so .skip / .todo cannot silently mask a regression. To raise the bar, update this file with freshly measured numbers + a new measuredAt/masterSha; never lower a number without an explicit baseline re-baseline decision.
toleranceNote: v8 coverage is execution-path based and mostly cross-platform deterministic, but a few async setup/teardown paths execute non-deterministically between runs. The 0.08pp tolerance absorbs this run-to-run variance with margin. Absolute floors are set at floor(measured)-1 to absorb the same noise without tripping locally.
